See Screenshots for the plugin interface; the captain uses the conversation's"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"tion. See Screenshots for the plugin interface; the captain uses the conversation's selected model.*"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Community plugin v0.1.9** · Tag
>
> This release targets **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1** and add"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s **individual member chat**: hover a Team in the composer, then select one member to run the Sessio"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"n as that member with its own role card, tools, Team Skills, and model route. It also moves member r"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"outing to `agent.model.select()` and per-step tool admission. Requires Agent Teams; keep 0.1.8 on ol"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"der hosts. Prebuilt artifacts are included."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### What's new in 0.1.9"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Talk to one member directly.** The composer's Team picker now shows a member panel on hover. Sel"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ecting a member injects its role card, tool policy, Team Skills, and model route into the current Se"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ssion; selecting the captain keeps the Session model unchanged.
- **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.** M"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ember routes are recorded through `agent.model.select()` and tool admission is evaluated per step. T"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"he plugin refuses an unusable member route before applying anything instead of falling back to the c"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"aptain.
- **Custom tool policies are native-only.** On PTC presets the plugin preserves the deployme"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"nt's executor and explicitly refuses custom allow-lists; PTC still works with the all-tools mode.
- "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"**Built-in troubleshooting skill.** The global `agent-team-presets-troubleshooting` skill explains T"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"eam application, member creation, route evidence, Team Skill visibility, and install/upgrade failure"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"m application, member creation, route evidence, Team Skill visibility, and install/upgrade failures."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**dsh-agent-team-presets** is a visual Team preset and private skill manager for DeepSeek Harness. C"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"onfigure a Team once, assign per-agent isolated skills, then select it from the conversation compose"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"r whenever you need it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"A Team contains a **captain** and any number of **member roles**:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- The captain uses the conversation's selected model, with its own role description, system prompt, "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"and tool policy.
- Each member can have an independent provider, model, reasoning effort, system pro"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"mpt, tool policy, and assigned Team Skills.
- The captain summons members through `spawn_team_member"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"`; native Agent Teams provides messaging, the shared task board, and runtime coordination."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"This is a community plugin, not the Harness's bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-pres"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ets` development package."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Why this plugin?"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness already ships Agent Teams with multi-agent collaboration. In the Harness versions t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"his plugin supports, per-Team configuration, skill isolation, and reuse are still left to the user, "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"which is what this plugin addresses:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Teams are hard to reuse.** In those versions, native teams focus on runtime creation and collabo"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ration, with no visual preset management; this plugin saves, duplicates, categorizes, and reuses nam"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ed presets.
- **Role setup is repetitive.** Each role's name, description, system prompt, and tool p"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"olicies are configured once instead of re-described every time.
- **Splitting work across models is "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"awkward.** Every member picks its own model and reasoning effort, so one Team combines models by tas"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"k, while the captain keeps leading on the Session's model.
- **Tool permissions have no fine-grained"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" entry point.** In those versions the native tool surface offers no per-role allow-list; here the ca"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ptain and each member carry their own, so roles differ in what they may use.
- **Skills lack per-age"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"nt scope isolation.** Shipped or user skills are typically registered globally, making all skills vi"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"sible to every agent; this plugin provides a private Team Skill library where skills are discovered "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"**only** by the specific Agent they are assigned to.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`.** Verified against **`0.2.2-rc.1`**. Each member's route"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" is recorded through `agent.model.select()` for fresh, forked, and cold-resumed execution; the capta"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"in keeps the conversation's model selection. The plugin manager enforces `engines.dsh` from package."},{"id":"p17s4","text":"json.
- **Custom tool allow-lists require a native Agent preset (standard or cordis).** This Host ca"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"nnot restore an inherited executor after a temporary override, so the plugin preserves the deploymen"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t's executor and explicitly refuses custom policies on PTC. PTC remains available with the all-tools"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" mode. Select a native Agent preset before using custom policies.
- **Agent Teams enabled in the tar"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"get profile.** The standard integration is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`, which"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" supplies the Team service, tools, and Web roster. This plugin configures and manages Teams; it does"},{"id":"p17s10","text":" not replace that subsystem.
- **A Web or Desktop profile with Settings and the required client serv"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ices.** Install into the profile you actually use, typically `web` for the Web GUI or `desktop` for "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"Desktop.
- **Durable storage and a continuable subagent backend for member execution.** Member creat"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"ion is refused if the storage domain or selected execution backend is unavailable. The default backe"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"nd names are `spawn` and `fork`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The plugin version (`0.1.9`) and the Harness version (`0.2.2-rc.1`, for example) are separate versio"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"in version (`0.1.9`) and the Harness version (`0.2.2-rc.1`, for example) are separate version lines."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Tool permissions and security"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Known limitation: Windows verification"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The path-separator and executable-resolution fixes are exercised by unit tests that normalize separa"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tors and by `ENOTDIR` cases, but no Windows machine was available here. Junction handling across vol"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"umes, `PATHEXT` resolution against a real `PATH`, and the full native build chain still need a Windo"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ws run before the release is described as Windows-verified."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Security boundaries"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- The allow-list is **not a filesystem, process, or network sandbox**. Allowed tools (such as bash) "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"retain their native capabilities. Maintain appropriate Harness sandbox and approval policies.
- Cust"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"om policy mode disallows general-purpose `run_code` and ordinary `subagent` / `workflow` delegation "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"to preserve strict policy contracts. Use preset Team members for delegation.
- Managed members requi"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"re their durable configuration on resume. Missing or corrupted records are refused loud rather than "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"falling back to unrestricted defaults."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Troubleshooting and limitations"}],"truncated":true}
